roadmap.title: Play the story — 60 to 80 hours
roadmap.text: Finish all 5 chapters and enjoy it. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends — the only possibly-missable trophy in the list. Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go: progress already counts toward 100% even though the checklist only opens after the story. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots, 1 autosave). Cheats disable trophies and saving, so leave them off.

roadmap.title: 100% Completion Checklist — about 100 hours
roadmap.text: After the story the checklist opens at Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. It is closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 15 target decks, all 42 shooting-range golds and all 14 drone races. Nothing on it is missable — everything is still doable in free-roam.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup — about 10 hours
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 stranger strands that count toward the trophy, then mop up the partner and robbery one-offs. Nothing here is missable: every quest giver is still around in free-roam after the story, and optional missions that expire never count toward a trophy.

roadmap.title: Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
roadmap.text: About 200 hours in total, difficulty 4 out of 10, one playthrough, no mission replay, free-roam after the story. The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are yours.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. Nothing else is needed: no multiplayer, no DLC. Plan on roughly 200 hours all in, at difficulty 4 out of 10.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish the first mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it pops at the end of the mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. It pops when Chapter 1 ends, after its last mission and the start of Chapter 2's first mission, What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 2; it pops as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4 by completing its final mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the final mission of the game (PowerPyx lists it as Chapter 4's Starting From Zero). It pops at the end of the mission and free-roam opens afterwards.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% Completion Checklist unlocks after the story (Touch Pad, Progress, Stats, 100% Completion); anything you did during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It is closer to 60% true completion: you need any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets and 15 of 18 meditations. Do optional missions as they appear — there are 200 to 300 or more in total, far more than the 100 needed.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the game's 397 stunts count (100% needs 300): 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix categories and pick the quickest — flying under bridges is the fastest. Track them under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Do one of each — check Touch Pad, Progress, Activities to see what is left. Most happen naturally while you chase other trophies.
sources: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. The golds are not too hard — take your time and use each range's own scoring to learn its layout.
sources: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 races in total). You only need one win per location, not every race.
sources: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the easiest ones and skip the rest; a win in any race type counts.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are on the TV at home (use the controllers), while Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You must reach the end of the game; beating every challenge inside it is not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Finish her 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline opens in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams. He calls, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — use the metal detector to dig it from the ocean floor and bring it back. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2 to 3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up). Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain stranger strands count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The confirmed ones are Kirk (Skunk Ape: Skunk Apeology 101, tree effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (street race, Bumper to Bumper, race, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (the Last Mile deliveries). Finish any 8; more strands are still being confirmed, so watch the count on the trophy tracker.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars — track them under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List, scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is wanted, then deliver it to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Cars he marks appear in fixed spots, but you can also steal them off the street; the east side, around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, is the best hunting ground. Delivering in good condition pays more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs around Vice City — destroy them in Take Out Kitty Litter, then finish Spin On This to shut the labs down. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE possibly-missable trophy. There are 18 meditation spots in 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts twice, and the last spot needs both characters playable together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). Do the Chapter 1 one first: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept — it vanishes once Chapter 1 ends, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so don't skip it. Track spots under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. (100% only needs 15 of 18, so a missed Chapter 1 spot can't cost you the 100% trophy.)
sources: Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts about Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Hunt the animals he marks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (collect it from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation); one clean shot keeps a kill pristine and pays more. There are 15 Target Decks, all needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. (100% needs 15 full sets, so this trophy comes long before you finish the collection.)
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up, then R1): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures all count, and there are more than 100 in total, so scan whatever you pass.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (100% needs 70, so this pops on the way). Track them under Progress, Challenges; most fill in naturally while you work on other trophies — save the easiest ones for last.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Needs both characters together, so earliest is after Chapter 2's Coffee Break: call your partner (hold Right and Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone. Easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter can't see you. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission That's Where The Money Is, which hands you 4-star heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call your partner and rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — stay in the flashing red and blue search state, not the solid red heat. Stock up on an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix or Adrenaline) first. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well (they open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): loot a few items in each and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop; if it doesn't, hit a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 while looking at a vehicle) — you don't need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing. There are 557 vehicles at launch; 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this pops on the way. Check totals under Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus (L3 and R3 while aiming) slows time and marks weak spots, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks, a wash or shower, and Adrenaline (L1 and Triangle) to stretch the slow-mo. Then line up 5 enemies — gang-operation criminals work best — and drop them with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It doesn't seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (check Touch Pad, Jason and Lucia, Focus); shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots raise it, so it gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — not one parked on the airfield. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and walk straight in. Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport before it pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive in through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks jewelry-store robberies and the Snap Gun. Enter a store through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door sets off the alarm), find the safe-code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. It pops shortly after you leave. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is — it teaches bank-vault robbery: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (finish his two Payday Loan robberies first) and follow the purple van icons. There are 8 large bank jobs; 5 earn the trophy, all 8 are needed for 100%. Each vault pays up to $205,000 and triggers 4-star heat — escape on a fast bike, then switch cars to break recognition.
sources: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The same Chapter 4 mission, That's Where The Money Is, counts: robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Earlier option: block an armored truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you've done his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map — fly a plane over every blacked-out area until the whole of Leonida is visible. A plane is far faster than driving it.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs (39 operations in total; all 39 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way). They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar, looking out over Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Only that blue Banshee counts, and the pop is slightly delayed, so keep driving after you smash out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway — blow it with sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police. It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and if you miss an item the robbery icon respawns later, so it isn't missable — you don't need all 3 in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check Touch Pad, Jason and Lucia, Strength, the heart icon). Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between them. Buy a fitness-club membership and always train together — call your partner (hold Right and Triangle) and the one not working out trains automatically, so you progress twice as fast. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your criminal profile — the trophy list shows your count out of 500. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. Profiles run Professional (stealthy jobs, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable (permanent — avoid it). It fills passively through robberies and fights; if it's the last one left, running over civilians and cops in a car farms it fast.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Still unconfirmed at the time of writing: PowerPyx believes it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way, in Little Cuba, Vice City. No confirmed method yet; check the source page for updates before chasing it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: go solo to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods — a UFO hangs in the sky in bright blue light. Approach it and it drops an abducted woman; talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random: if the car isn't there, drive away and come back.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded spots like Vice City streets or Ocean Beach are the place to do it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one job, so this comes naturally from the 100% robberies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest, so they get you there fastest; the game counts every shop type, from the 24 Ammu-Nations to the 67 clothing stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (4 more are story-related and don't count). They open after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Total cost is about $160,000; robberies in Chapters 3 and 4 are the fastest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Register 10 stolen vehicles through it: drive them to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. You need enough garage parking spots first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds spots. At first Moses only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the registration fees down.
